load_pickle_file: load a pickle file and return the deserialized data object
save_pickle_file: save data to a pickle file using the highest protocol version
load_compressed_pickle: load a gzip compressed pickle file with the .pklz extension
save_compressed_pickle: save data to a gzip compressed pickle file using the .pklz extension
review_load_pickle: review the load_pickle function to understand how it handles compressed and uncompressed pickle files
